annotations.title: Archive, restore or delete a collection

description: Move a collection through its lifecycle by naming the target `state`: "archived" archives a live collection (a reversible retirement that hides it from the timeline, recall and search; nothing deleted, no storage freed) - and, on a collection already scheduled for deletion, cancels that deletion and leaves it archived; "live" restores an archived collection; "deletion_scheduled" schedules an ARCHIVED collection for permanent deletion after a 30-day grace window (recoverable until then via state=archived or live; then content, files and history are erased in every workspace it was shared into). Archive before scheduling deletion. Scheduling a deletion needs delete permission even though the tool is gated on update.

id.description: id is the collection to move.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

state.description:
state is the target lifecycle state:
   "live"               - make an archived collection live again (restore);
   "archived"           - archive a live collection, OR cancel a scheduled
                          deletion, leaving the collection archived;
   "deletion_scheduled" - schedule permanent deletion of an archived
                          collection after the 30-day grace window. This
                          transition still requires delete permission (the
                          domain enforces it), even though the tool is gated
                          on update - an update-only caller is refused here.

name: set_collection_state
title: Archive, restore or delete a collection
